verdict.rationale: Published benchmarks and measured latency or recall numbers are a fair thing to ask of a vector database, so the axis applies. However, none of the evidence items contains benchmark results or latency/recall figures. The pack covers only features such as hybrid search, multi-tenancy, replication, backups and model integrations.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims
